                                         ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1 Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance is
hereby amended by changing all of RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-L in the area bounded by:

        West Potomac Avenue; the public alley next west of North Central Avenue;
        a line 52.32 feet south of and parallel to West Potomac Avenue; and North
        Central Avenue;

to those of a RT 4.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.
